_comment: A broken cavalry block's leading riders, held back for a moment by a hill they meet, rejoin their ranks as the flight swings round it. Team 0's 72 horses (default Cavalry geometry for 72: 9 files by 8 ranks, about 320 wu wide and 840 wu deep, file pitch 40 wu, rank pitch 120 wu) spawn ALREADY routing (starting_state 3, morale 1.0) facing north, their own back edge, with their front rank at y 1080 and a hill (block terrain, x 880-1180, y 820-1040) 40 wu ahead of it across the block's four western files. The block's centre line (x 1220) runs 40 wu east of the hill's east end. The flight runs north-east round the hill's east end; the western riders touch the face (soldiers_at_block_terrain_edge 2 at tick 120) and fall behind their places while the flight swings round. Each rider more than half a rank pitch off his place may now change his velocity faster than his own acceleration, by as much as his place's own feed-forward changes (SoldierBodies.flight_accel_share, capped at twice his acceleration), so he no longer loses ground on a place that turns and speeds up faster than he can. Measured 2026-11-05 on Windows with full state dumps at the declared ticks, seeds 0 to 4 (all identical: nothing here draws on the seed), against main 806be006: slot_distance_max (the farthest any rider stands from his place) is 103.6, 114.5 and 114.2 wu at ticks 240, 300 and 350, with no rider more than one rank pitch (120 wu) off; on main 126.9, 185.9 and 227.0 wu, with 1, 2 and 7 riders more than a rank pitch off. The slot_distance_max pins at ticks 300 and 350 allow one rank pitch, which main exceeds at both. The anchor's path moves little (about (1348.5, 1235.2) at tick 300 and (1376.6, 1120.7) at tick 350, against (1348.4, 1236.5) and (1376.9, 1127.0) on main), since only the riders who have fallen out of their ranks take the extra. The tick-8 position pins are setup pins (the spawn), not claims about the fix. A routing unit's rout timer (6 s) runs out at tick 360 and it rallies; the clip ends at tick 352, just before that. A small idle team-1 Infantry block 620 wu west keeps the router in the close sim tier; all_teams_control leaves both sides without AI. Flat declared map apart from the hill; drill mode. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
